basic_info.description: Discover this hidden gem in one of the loveliest parts of the Parkside neighborhood! This mostly detached, split-level home is nestled on a serene, tree-lined street and is perfectly located near Pine Lake Park. As you arrive at the formal entry you will appreciate the elegance of the light filled living room which includes coved ceilings, parquet wood floors and a wood burning fireplace. The formal dining room has plaster crown molding and leads directly to the kitchen.  The renovated kitchen includes new solid wood cabinets, quartz counters, Thermador convection oven and dedicated breakfast room. The upper level has two generous sized bedrooms. The remodeled bathroom includes a European style vanity, walk-in shower with frameless glass door and designer tile. The rear yard is low maintenance with a brick & concrete patio, new fences on three sides and a storage shed. The full garage has 2-car parking, a laundry area and an abundance of storage. Ideal Opportunity for an Ideal Home.
